user_saw: Users running the bundled Codex could find GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra missing from its native model list.
summary: The fix upgrades bundled Codex and its matching version pins to 0.169.0 and regenerates protocol validators to accept uploaded audio references.
reasoning: The path history shows that OpenClaw pinned Codex 0.164.0 before GPT-6.2 arrived, and the fix's native discovery test confirms the app-server sends its binary version to the catalog endpoint. The PR reports that the newer CLI could see the models, but its catalog test mocks the provider response, so live availability was not independently verified. The GPT-6.2 catalog and inference relay commits changed separate paths, while the old protocol validator's rejection of the new audio fileId payload was reproduced directly.
